rows.replacement: No band replied. A band replies only when it is awake and not connected to another phone.

rows.comment: "Almost always" is a vague claim and "rather than a fault in the band" rebuts a worry nobody raised.
lineComments: State the cause once and drop the rebuttal.
rows.replacement: The band rejected the encryption key. The usual cause is an old pairing record for the band on this phone.

rows.comment: Semicolon chain is hard to scan.

rows.comment: The second sentence is clunky; say plainly who can remove the record.
lineComments: Keep the steps, tighten the reason.
rows.replacement: Open the phone’s Bluetooth settings, forget the band, then scan again here. Only the system can remove the old pairing record.

rows.comment: "Normally works" is a vague claim; give the instruction.
lineComments: Turn the claim into a step with the distance.
rows.replacement: Scan again with the band within one metre of the phone.

rows.comment: "Four numbers" is vague and sex is not a number; name the fields.
lineComments: Name the four inputs and say what blank does.
rows.replacement: Sex, age, height and weight change how your data is scored. If you leave one blank, only the metrics that need it are unavailable.

"It" has no antecedent; say what is unavailable.
